title: A02 Ingestion patterns cheat sheet
subtitle: ASSOCIATE SERIES · A02 · SECTION 2 INGESTION (21%) QUICK REFERENCE

pages.title: Batch · incremental · streaming
lede: Section 2: ingestion patterns (batch, streaming, incremental), local files, Lakeflow Connect connectors.
Free Edition: serverless, Unity Catalog volumes, Auto Loader. Fictional orders only.

blocks.heading: 1. Three patterns
blocks.code:
batch        spark.read ... load(src)        reads EVERY file, every run
incremental  Auto Loader + checkpoint         only files not yet processed
streaming    same engine, runs continuously   the trigger decides how often
blocks.note: Batch + append = duplicates on every rerun. Batch should overwrite.

blocks.heading: 2. Landing zone: a Unity Catalog volume
blocks.note: A volume stores files under Unity Catalog governance.

blocks.heading: 3. Batch load (comma-separated values, CSV)
blocks.code:
df = (spark.read.format("csv").option("header", "true")
        .schema("order_id INT, customer STRING, amount DOUBLE, order_date DATE").load(src))
df.write.mode("overwrite").saveAsTable("...orders_batch")
blocks.note: Day 1: 3 rows. Day 2: re-reads both files, 5 rows.

blocks.heading: 4. Incremental load: Auto Loader
blocks.note: Day 2 reads only orders_day2.csv (2 rows). The checkpoint loads each file once.

pages.title: Triggers, local files, Lakeflow Connect

blocks.heading: 5. Triggers on serverless
blocks.code:
availableNow=True        process all new data, then stop   (serverless OK)
once=True                deprecated, still supported
processingTime / continuous   NOT on serverless notebooks or jobs
                         -> INFINITE_STREAMING_TRIGGER_NOT_SUPPORTED
blocks.note: Always-on: a pipeline in continuous mode, or availableNow in a continuous job. Schedule incremental runs with Lakeflow Jobs.

blocks.heading: 6. Local files
blocks.code:
New > Add or upload data > Create or modify table   one-time load -> managed Delta table
Catalog > volume > Upload to this volume           keep files, read them with code
blocks.note: Uploads suit small reference files, not data that keeps arriving.

blocks.heading: 7. Lakeflow Connect connectors
blocks.code:
standard  Spark + Structured Query Language (SQL) application programming interfaces (APIs)
          Auto Loader, COPY INTO, Structured Streaming (Kafka). You maintain the logic.
managed   connection + ingestion pipeline, configured not coded. Software as a service
          (SaaS) like Salesforce, Workday, SharePoint, or SQL Server databases.
blocks.note: Managed: authentication, retries, schema changes handled. Free Edition: needs a real source; database change data capture (CDC) is paid-only. Concepts here.

blocks.heading: 8. Scenario words
blocks.text: Small, fully replaced, daily snapshot, one-time upload -> batch (overwrite). New files keep arriving, process only new data, never reprocess -> Auto Loader + checkpoint. Seconds or minutes latency -> streaming. Supported SaaS app or database -> managed connector.

blocks.heading: Practice challenge
blocks.text: Day 3 adds 4 orders; run both loads. Answer: orders_batch 9 (overwrite); Auto Loader reads 4, bronze 9; if all three batch runs appended: 3 + 5 + 9 = 17 rows with duplicates.
